Poll List Media Uploads to follow progress. ```javascript curl -X POST \ 'https://www.wixapis.com/gbp/v1/bulk/media-uploads/create' \ -H 'Authorization: ' \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -d '{ "mediaUploads": [ { "locationId": "locations/8117348495523092385", "slotKey": "logo", "sourceUrl": "https://static.wixstatic.com/media/bakery-logo.png", "category": "LOGO", "format": "PHOTO", "operation": "CREATE" }, { "locationId": "locations/8117348495523092385", "slotKey": "cover", "sourceUrl": "https://static.wixstatic.com/media/bakery-storefront.jpg", "category": "COVER", "format": "PHOTO", "operation": "CREATE" }, { "locationId": "locations/8117348495523092385", "slotKey": "photo:a3f8c112", ... snippet cut here — INCOMPLETE example, do not use as-is; read the full doc for the complete example ... ``` ... 9 more lines ... --- Method Response Shape --- ## Method Response Shape ```json { "results": [ "object" ], "bulkActionMetadata": { "totalSuccesses": "integer", "totalFailures": "integer", "undetailedFailures": "integer" } } ``` --- Method Description --- ## Method Description: Queues photo changes for one location and returns without calling Google. Every item must target the same `locationId`, and one call has to be either all additions or all removals. Send two calls to do both. To add a photo, set `slotKey`, `sourceUrl`, `category` and `format`. To remove one, set `slotKey` and `mediaKey`. Everything else is assigned by the server. `sourceUrl` has to stay reachable well after this call returns, not just until it does. Google fetches the image when the queue reaches it, which may be minutes later, and a failure report renders the same URL as a thumbnail possibly weeks later. Queuing clears the location's previous failures. Every failed item for the location goes, not just the ones matching what you're sending, so a site owner only ever sees the most recent set and retrying failures is just another call to this method carrying those items. That clearing isn't scoped to you. If another app manages the same location, queuing here discards failures it may not have read yet, and vice versa. Read List Media Uploads before queuing if you need to preserve them. Duplicates are dropped rather than queued twice, so a double click or a client retry won't add the same photo twice. An item that's already queued comes back as a success carrying the existing item's `id`. Google doesn't deduplicate by URL itself, so this is what protects you from a double post. The server decides the order, not the order you send. Marketplace providers call this method to report completion of asynchronous mockup generation initiated via [Bulk Generate Mockups](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/suppliers-hub/marketplace-provider-service-plugin/bulk-generate-mockups). Include the generated mockup URL when `status` is `COMPLETED`, or set `status` to `FAILED` for products where generation couldn't be completed. Each mockup is keyed by the combination of provider, `providerProductId`, and `imageType`, so a product can have a separate mockup submitted for each supported image type (for example, `SITE_LOGO` and `CUSTOM`). Providers can batch results across multiple calls in any grouping—there's no requirement to submit all products from a given [Bulk Generate Mockups](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/suppliers-hub/marketplace-provider-service-plugin/bulk-generate-mockups) request in a single submission. ## Method Permissions: suppliershub:v2:marketplace-provider-submission:submit-generated-mockups ## Method Permissions Scopes: Write Marketplace: SCOPE.SUPPLIERS_HUB.WRITE_MARKETPLACE ## Method Schema Summary: The `submitGeneratedMockups` method is a POST request to `https://www.wixapis.com/suppliershub/v2/submit-generated-mockups`. It allows marketplace providers to submit generated mockup images for products. The method accepts one parameter: * `mockups`: An array of mockup generation results. Each object in the array must contain: * `providerProductId` (string): The product's GUID on the provider's platform. * `imageType` (ImageType): The type of image used for the mockup. Possible values are `SITE_LOGO`, `CUSTOM`, or `FALLBACK`. * `status` (MockupStatus): The status of the mockup generation. Possible values are `PENDING`, `COMPLETED`, or `FAILED`. * `mockupUrl` (string): The URL of the generated mockup image. This is required only when the `status` is `COMPLETED`. ... 16 more lines ... > Next: read the full method article at https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/business-solutions/suppliers-hub/marketplace-provider-submissions/submit-generated-mockups using the suitable read tool to get the complete code examples and method description. > If you need more detail about the request or response shape, read the full method schema using the suitable tool. --- #### [assets/media/media-manager/files/resumable-upload-api](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/assets/media/media-manager/files/resumable-upload-api) ## Resource: Resumable Upload API ## Article: Resumable Upload API ## Article Link: https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/assets/media/media-manager/files/resumable-upload-api ## Article Content: # Upload a File with a Generated Resumable File Upload URL To upload a file to a site's Media Manager with a URL that allows you to pause and resume an upload, you can call [Generate File Resumable Upload URL](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/assets/media/media-manager/files/generate-file-resumable-upload-url). Changes are > queued per location, identified by Google's location ID. ## Save a full gallery The site owner has arranged a gallery of photos and hits save. Google accepts only about 10 edits per minute per profile, so apply the whole set through the queue instead of one immediate write per photo. 1. Collect the changes. Each addition needs a publicly reachable `sourceUrl`, a `category` such as `LOGO`, `COVER`, or `INTERIOR`, and `format: "PHOTO"`. 2. The homepage gets its own method because its suggestions are generated with homepage-specific guidance, representing the whole site, not one topic. Same contract as Trigger Page Optimization: the homepage's focus keyword must be set first, the call returns a `predictionId` to poll, and triggering is idempotent per page while a job is in progress. Must be called with a [Wix user identity](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/articles/authentication/about-identities). Calls made with an API key fail. ## Method Permissions: seo:suggestions:v1:page_optimization:trigger_home_page_optimization ## Method Permissions Scopes: Manage SEO Settings: SCOPE.PROMOTE.MANAGE-SEO ## Method Schema Summary: This API method, `triggerHomePageOptimization`, initiates the generation of optimization suggestions specifically for a website's homepage. It requires the `pageId` (GUID of the homepage) and `pagePath` (URL path, typically `/`) as parameters. The method returns a `predictionId`, which is a GUID for the generation job that can be used to poll for results. Calls to this method must be authenticated with a Wix user identity, not an API key. The operation is idempotent if a job is already in progress for the page. **Parameters:** * `pageId`: (string) The GUID of the site's homepage. Required. * `pagePath`: (string) The URL path of the homepage.
